field_edits.updated_text: There is moderate acromioclavicular joint space narrowing and mild to moderate glenohumeral joint space narrowing with subchondral sclerosis along the glenoid. Subcortical cystic changes are present at the humeral head. No dislocation. The remaining joint spaces and articular margins are preserved.

impression:
